metadata_only_repair.remaining_gates: Fresh unchanged metadata plans required; previous region-only rejection skipped path timing.

findings.region_only: 38 routes have exactly two destination links and all 76 places lack state. No direct catalog-link fallback remains. Four existing Washington destinations now have hashed Census evidence. The 72 places on the other 36 routes remain outside the US repair scope.
findings.zero_distance_elevation_jump: All 15 are 3D and finite; each has exactly one same-XY/different-Z edge. Removing or averaging that vertex would invent an elevation decision. Inspect source and ordered segment elevations, then use a reviewed exact-XY reprofile only if independent source evidence supports it.
findings.elevation_job_limitation: Existing route-elevation-jobs.ts candidates test missing/encoded profile, real elevation range, gain/loss mismatch, and segment profiles. Existing finite ranged profiles can be reused without detecting same-XY/different-Z edges; blindly rerunning it is not a demonstrated repair. No elevation worker change is proposed here.
findings.missing_first_trailhead: All 14 have one destination and one segment. This is missing identity/access evidence, not a harmless ordinal renumbering. Bind an existing real source-supported trailhead at the actual start within the unchanged limit or rebuild through the source graph.
findings.legacy_no_segments_or_shape: All 120 have zero segment links and no shape; preserve route identity and require real source geometry/shared matcher before new links. Do not infer shape or fabricate segments from route names. Two missing summit identities (Rattlesnake Ledge and Camp Muir) need kind/objective review rather than invented summit links.
findings.long_distance_routes: AT/CDT/PCT have no destination joins, missing gain/loss, old non-OSM source kinds, and multi-region extent. Keep a separate reviewed traverse task; no metadata-only repair clears their blockers.
